codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Maintain every project-local verification skill feature map through source reconciliation, a coordinator-owned live pass, explicit outcomes, and surviving evidence.

native_mapping.fallback: Without native bounded delegation, read source entries sequentially and preserve the same return shape. Without a live verification surface, return blocked with the attempted route and prerequisite.
native_mapping.availability: fixture_proven adapter; live target application not supplied
native_mapping.routing_authority: proof-orchestrator selects the proof path; model-capability-router remains the standing model authority

external_dependencies: target application runtime or supplied harness
permission_gates: Edit only the selected verification skill's own project-local directory under .agents/skills/verify-*.
Never edit product code, global skills, the mirror source, or the marketplace from this maintenance flow.
The coordinator owns all live driving and health checks; delegates are read-only source readers.
Do not open, publish, or merge a PR without separate explicit authorization; run notes remain scratch evidence.
Missing target, live surface, or prerequisite returns blocked and preserves the target.

behavioral_proof.positive: Fixture selects one project-local verification target, reconciles its feature files, and leaves evidence outside cleanup scope.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Fixture without bounded delegation uses the sequential fallback, and a missing live target returns blocked with no product edit.
behavioral_proof.error: Ambiguous target or failed doctor is reported explicitly and does not broaden the edit scope.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

codex_note:
## Codex adaptation boundary

This mirror maintains only the explicitly selected project-local verification skill under `.agents/skills/verify-*/`. The coordinator owns the live pass and proof-orchestrator selects its proof level. Source readers may use native bounded delegation when exposed, but the sequential fallback is valid and must preserve the same return shape. A missing or unhealthy target is `blocked` with the attempted route and prerequisite. The maintenance flow never edits product code or global skills, and it never opens, publishes, or merges a PR without separate authorization.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use for /maintain-verification-skill or "audit the verify skill".
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic renderer are static provenance. Focused tests render the held candidate into a temporary project-local fixture and exercise target selection, sequential fallback, and scope/error outcomes.
reason: The adapter changes the project-local target path and delegation boundary while leaving the pinned upstream source unchanged.
